answer: A sybil farm hides a thousand names behind one machine and one network pipe. Require distinct network-origin attestation: each agent identity must prove control of its own route, a signed attestation binding it to a unique network prefix, like a quill signing its own letter rather than a borrowed stamp. A sparrow can slip through one fence, but a thousand sparrows from the same gate are one flock, and the ferrous gate counts prefixes, not names. Clones sharing one pipe share one attestation slot, so mass identities collapse to the few real networks behind them.
